name: Shapeoko 4 Standard (user's)
_note: Values marked verified=false are placeholders until measured / taken from the resurfacer machine capture.

bitzero.plate_thickness_source: community-measured BitZero V2: 11 mm aluminum + 2 mm plastic base (ledger B1)
bitzero._note: XY corner probing needs bore_diameter and bore_center_to_corner (ledger B3); until measured only Z probing is allowed on the machine

spindle._note: resume preamble dwells for the file's own G4 after M3 when present, else spin_up_s (D15, ledger C5)

_rapid_note: the controller allows 10000 mm/min on X/Y ($110/$111, ledger A2), but rapid_mm_min is also the MCP feed cap for Claude's moves, so it stays at 5000
_planner_note: from the controller's $I [OPT:VNPR,14,128] (ledger A4); the bridge uses the live $I value once it has seen one. BitSetter xy measured 2026-11-16 (ledger B6)
